plots.name: Hive against air, by hour and humidity

notes.text: WORKFLOW: colour by hour of day. Plot one temperature against another and each day traces a loop, because the hive follows the air a few hours late. Colour by (Data tab, under Points) reads the binned time as the hour of day on a cyclic scale, so midnight and the next midnight are the same dark colour and noon is light. 'Colour the line too' colours each line segment by the hour it starts at. Size by (just below) draws each point by the air's relative humidity, its area growing with the value between the smallest and largest size you set; the size key sits under the colour bar. A logger outage on day 3 leaves blank hours; the line breaks there, as any line does, unless Join gaps is on.
